title: VLAN mismatch between two switches
description: Hosts on the same IP subnet cannot ping each other after moving a patch cable between switches.
symptom: PCs in the same IP subnet (192.168.10.0/24) can reach their access switch but cannot ping each other after one PC was moved to a different switch. The trunk link between the two switches is up.
diagnosis: Confirm the PCs have correct and matching IP addresses, masks and gateways.
Run 'show vlan brief' on both switches to check the access ports' VLAN assignment.
Run 'show interfaces trunk' to confirm the trunk is operational and allowing the required VLAN.
Run 'show mac address-table' to see whether the switch is learning MACs in the expected VLAN.
resolution: The access port on switch 2 was left in VLAN 1 instead of VLAN 10. Reconfigure the port with 'switchport access vlan 10' and verify the VLAN is allowed across the trunk with 'switchport trunk allowed vlan add 10'.
